title: The Kinesiology Major
description:
Restriction: Must be in a major within the SPHL-Kinesiology department, and permission of department.
Credit only granted for: KNES289z or KNES205.
Formerly: KNES289z.
Additional information: This course is part of the Kinesiology Transfer Cluster and should be taken with KNES370 and KNES156 or another advisor-approved physical activity course for optimal course sequencing.
